title: The Five People You Meet in Heaven
author: Mitch Albom
summary: Eddie, an elderly maintenance man at a seaside amusement park, dies in an accident and wakes in an afterlife where five people from his past explain how his life touched theirs.
readIf: you want a short, sentimental fable about whether an ordinary life mattered.
skipIf: you find tidy life lessons and sentiment too sweet or too obvious.
